description.value:
A canvas field jacket with steel plates sewn into the chest and back panels over a quilted liner — the faction line-infantry pattern, issued by the crate alongside the Service Rifle. Heavier than it looks and warmer than anyone wants in a Bad Eden summer, but it stops what a militia expects to be shot with.

No signature, no harmonization. Name on the tape.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Armor: Medium
  • Defense: Guard +5
  • Requires: Bracing (trained)
  • Tier: IV
  • Cost: 190 Nonlethal marks

⟡ Crowned (+3). Keyed to a true name. It will not be sold.

  • +3 on each of its defense bonuses → Guard +5 (rank-scaled like all armor: Trained half, Proficient full).
  • Grade raises it to Tier IV · soulbound — one bearer, no sale.

item.signature: Canvas on the outside, sheet-steel on the inside, a faction stencil on the back.
